description: Open Spark's workspace for inventory, purchasing and receiving: browse stock, review reorder recommendations, preview and confirm draft purchase orders, and inspect existing drafts. Use view=purchasing or view=receiving for those workflows. Pass itemId to resolve an item identity through the tool channel. Opens with no arguments, for example from the assistant's app launcher. Credential-owned tenant and client confinement applies.

itemId.description: Optional item GUID to resolve an authorized identity for workspace selection.

search.description: Optional SKU or item name search, at most 200 characters.

view.description: Initial workspace view: inventory (default), purchasing or receiving.

name: open_inventory_workspace
title: Spark Workspace
